messages.subject: Project Redwood — heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Good to be working with you on this. We attach our draft heads of terms reflecting the agreed price of £21.75m, 10% deposit on exchange held as stakeholder, TOGC treatment, and a target exchange of 24 April / completion 15 May. We've included an exclusivity period to 9 May.

Grateful for your comments. We'd like to keep momentum given our client's 5 March board.

James

—

DX 134777 Bishopsgate | +44 (0)20 7946 0500

messages.subject: RE: Project Redwood — heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. The heads of terms look broadly fine. Two points from Hartmoor: (1) they'd prefer completion no later than 15 May as they have their own timetable; agreed in any event. (2) On the outstanding Mercer Wells review, the seller wants flexibility to keep negotiating with the tenant up to exchange — we can discuss the post-exchange consent mechanism in the contract.

Otherwise content. We'll turn the contract around shortly.

Alistair
